I added `items` to the order response, but I did not remove `lines`. Both fields are returned with the same content. `npm test` passes (39 tests).

I kept `lines` because CLAUDE.md says web-storefront uses `GET /orders/{id}` and its responses must stay backward compatible (ARCH-8). Renaming the field would break that consumer. I marked `lines` as `@deprecated` in the code.

The change is in `src/api/responses.ts`. `toOrderResponse` is shared, so `POST /orders`, `POST /orders/{id}/cancel` and `GET /orders` now return `items` as well. I updated the two assertions in `test/app.test.ts` that check the response shape.

I did not run `npm run arch` or `npm run typecheck`.

To finish the rename, web-storefront has to move to `items` first. After that, `lines` can be removed from the response. I can do that removal when you're ready.
